title: Live shows the next song, not only the next cue, in Cue-by-Cue
acceptance: When the current song's last cue is next, Cue-by-Cue shows the next song's title (for example 'Next song: Rollin''), so 'End of track' is not the only hint.
nextAction: Design copy for the Next row with the ux-copy guidance; small web change in Live Mode.

evidence.summary: Owner noticed during the 2026-10-29 iPhone probe.
